act.long_title: An Act to consolidate, define and amend the law of Evidence.

licence: Published with commentary and other original matter under s.52(1)(q)(ii), Copyright Act 1957.

section.heading: Evidence as to document unmeaning in reference to existing facts
section.html: When language used in a document is plain in itself, but is unmeaning in reference to existing facts, evidence may be given to show that it was used in a peculiar sense. Illustration A sells to B, by deed, “my house in Calcutta”. A had no house in Calcutta, but it appears that he had a house at Howrah, of which B had been in possession since the execution of the deed. These facts may be proved to show that the deed related to the house at Howrah.
